title: feat(nm2readsly): neighbor-read of M at t+1 on two-axis same-lock y-probes: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Neighbor-read of M on same-lock y-probes: HOLD at A,B,D, FAIL at C. C is the one probe whose M={+e_2} has no six-neighbour carrying exactly {+e_2}: the would-be match (0,3,0) never forms because A's lock forbids the perp step. This is the clearest ball-wall/formation-truncation effect on a verdict in the band.
